notes: PET-specific family evidence may support rescue; generic alpha/beta hydrolase/cutinase evidence alone remains REVIEW/CANDIDATE, never SUPPORTED.
MHET specificity cannot be inferred from broad hydrolase family alone; require strong sequence/annotation evidence.
All three TphA1/A2/A3 components are required; broad RHO domains alone do not establish terephthalate specificity.
PdxA-family domain is non-specific; require TphB-like sequence plus pathway context or exact annotation.

Cutinase/lipase family evidence is not PCL-specific. Generic domain evidence alone never proves PCL activity. v0.3 applies an additional stringent sequence gate (>=60% identity and >=80% query/reference coverage) to sequence-only support.
